added_failures_note: the reviewed run was fenced unarmed and records no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so no test was added and the added-failure count is zero by absence of arms; the node's own gate (probe_rows/check.py) is not a suite arm and its two failures are recorded in the findings.

findings.text: blocking: the imas-efit column is the 24-flux-loop arm while nova fits its 72-row set, so the two codes reconstruct from different information sets; plan §7 requires both codes reconstruct from the same rows, and the headline 9.7-10.4 mm against 29.7-38.3 mm comparison is therefore not a like-for-like code comparison.

blocking: done_when clause (2) fails for both codes (nova 0.047/0.085/0.105, imas-efit 0.462/0.544/0.606 against the 0.5 floor) and the gate exits 1, yet plan §7 says a pipeline failing this control is repaired before any comparison is read and the record states the comparison as its landed result; the positive control is not established.

non-blocking: the claim that the white half of the control rules out a 1/f draw the reduction failed to see does not follow, because a drift draw that was generated white would pass the white control and fail the drift one; the arm that rules the generator out is imas-efit's 0.462/0.544/0.606 on the same draw, not the white control.
non-blocking: the axis-against-slice figure plots the axis error in mm, whereas plan §7's figure clause names the axis position against slice index for both sequences on one panel.

non-blocking: arm_rows selects the figure's arm by the '-loops' tag while analyse.pick at analyse.py:303 selects the control's arm by minimum axis_rms, so the figure and the gate apply two different arm-selection rules; they coincide on this run's single efit arm but the manifest's claim that the two cannot disagree is overstated.

non-blocking: performed is incremented before the arm is even fetched, so the arm lookup counts as a check and the reported 'of 28' includes four no-op increments, overstating how many assertions the gate ran.
non-blocking: WIDTH and HEIGHT are defined and never called; main() hard-codes figsize=(7.2, 7.2) at paint.py:135, so the constants are dead code.

item_verdicts.done_when: done_when clause (1) is asserted by probe_rows/check.py:47 only for the slice count and slices_with_boundary; the RMS and 50-slice-mean quantities it names are reported but never asserted, and clause (2) is asserted (check.py:72-78) and reads CHECK-FAILED for both codes, 2 of 28 checks failed, EXIT=1 in study/logs/gate-check.log.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to report, over at least 200 slices for each code and each noise sequence, the RMS and lag-one of the axis position, boundary flux and q95 with the 50-slice-mean error beside the single-slice error (inverse-equilibrium-baseline.html:193); the landed table carries all of these for four arms at docs/evidence/fragments/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/drift-sequences-fit-iteration.html:33-38, but clause (2) is unmet and the two codes are not compared on the same rows.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states the four arms at 200 slices, the two failing 1/f lag-one clauses, and the two-pass cap; its artifact list and the gate log it names agree with the numbers in study/summary.json and study/table.json.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is scripts/prototypes/probe_rows/, scripts/prototypes/drifting_sensor_sequences/probe_rows/, the evidence fragment and the figure directory.

justifications.durability: No test file is added and none is in scope; probe_rows/check.py:47 re-reads the summary the production reduction already wrote, so no assertion fails if iteration.py, study.py or analyse.py regresses.
justifications.evidence: probe_rows/check.py:47 gates the slice count, boundary count and lag-one flags, and its result is recorded in study/logs/gate-check.log (EXIT=1), but it never asserts the RMS error or 50-slice-mean quantities clause (1) names.
justifications.fit: The new modules follow the surrounding prototype-script idiom (argparse main, HERE sys.path insert, save_checked) and use no plan or ticket label, though paint.py:27-28 leaves two dead constants.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The delivered table at docs/evidence/fragments/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/drift-sequences-fit-iteration.html:30-38 states all four arms at 200 slices, but the 1/f control fails for both codes and the efit column is the 24-loop arm against nova's 72 rows, so the comparison the goal exists to enable is not established.
justifications.reuse: probe_rows/iteration.py reuses study.py's noise, rows and geometry and analyse.reduce_arm rather than forking them, and the one new reduction field was added to the owner at analyse.py:210.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff (11 of them) is inside the declared write paths at scripts/prototypes/drifting_sensor_sequences/probe_rows/ and docs/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/drift-sequences-fit-iteration/.
